briefings.title: Snowflake CEO: How AI Agents Will Transform the Workplace | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Snowflake CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy outlines how AI agents and consumption-based data processing are transforming the software landscape, positioning generative AI model companies as Snowflake's primary competitive threat while driving rapid internal shifts toward spec-driven software development.

briefings.title: Snowflake Summit 2026 Opening Keynote With Sridhar Ramaswamy And Daniela Amodei
briefings.tldr: At Snowflake Summit 2026, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy declared the arrival of the "Agentic Enterprise," introducing Snowflake Intelligence and Cortex Code (CoCo) as secure, governance-first control planes designed to coordinate data, models, and SaaS applications to automate end-to-end business workflows.

briefings.title: Who’s Winning The AI Race? + Software’s Future — With Sridhar Ramaswamy
briefings.tldr: The AI race has shifted from an OpenAI monopoly to a fierce, multi-polar competition where technical leads shrink in months, forcing software companies to transition from static SaaS tools into "agentic platforms" that prioritize internal data integration over simple chat interfaces.
